name: generated-module-negotiated
description: Real-project plan RP2.1: the same generated-package/sibling-module project as generated-module-old-mcpp -- an mcpp too old to advertise mcpp.build-database (mcpp-mock.json's oldProtocol) -- but with a newer mock mcpp installed where producer negotiation looks for one (xim-x-mcpp/<version>/bin/mcpp under the fixture's isolated HOME). The server must find and use it instead of falling back to compile_commands.json: the status carries the producer-negotiated notice, and the project reaches tier 1 like generated-module itself, not tier 3.
